{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: is it really text with commas?
print("First few revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for commas in the revenue strings
print("\nAre there commas in revenue?", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Check for the special internal test orders
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99:", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
